a304de49d92d85b201a5e26ed14df86636c16d5f.statement: a lending service for a small library.

b3cd52948594564c14d10b87e3aeb9c91841b8af.statement: it tracks members, the books the library owns, and the loans between them.

310d735e5e4b18efd04a3cde8d6da2b83e9fc447.statement: other systems drive it over http.

8662edcfed4bc73627b78d8f6bc2f02d28e0d25b.statement: a member has a name, an email address, and the date they joined

a20450168f1d5255e570f8d9b9b718acaba408f9.statement: The system assigns every member a stable unique integer identifier that external systems can reference.

4f27f70d4616dc65c0c16364594942456f00d7a9.statement: users can register a member by providing a name and an email address

669f08f2374cf075d176874a1bee7b45103654fb.statement: The member's name must not be empty.

31c748230e50b3826850862ca9cd03339bf3d9fa.statement: A member's name must not exceed 120 characters.

f6ff5277cff19e2789def11fa9c96193f7cf6a70.statement: A member's email address must contain an @ symbol.

c94f15dead313a77c262c83e3578683c736e96a1.statement: A member's email address must not be empty.

d47cb6d246ee58ff7c94f91a34a3bc65656d3c26.statement: The system must never allow two members to share the same email address, and the system must reject a registration that repeats an existing email address.

fa098533b1d11e6c2220c8583d04b9921065ddfd.statement: Email is a conflict, not a validation error.

2389e6d06981beac0a2695ab379c481eaf6ebec8.statement: users can read a single member, including how many loans that member currently has out

bb7d2fb9081ab0b8c032f3e7d97d6e1db180bf7c.statement: users can remove a member only when that member has no active loan; removing a member who still

8404fa5924bb1956958c5e1f767be542b78c89d5.statement: Removing a member never deletes that member's returned loan history.

948d07abfa84c5ea31bb23f8e28040326fd5d9c9.statement: a book has a title, an author, an isbn, and a count of how many copies the library owns

46aa8fa025803db34191884e1fb8019733234bec.statement: The system assigns every book a stable unique integer identifier that external systems can reference.

f2ebe8478b89251d950032b22ba874dfd22834b4.statement: users can add a book by providing a title, an author, an isbn, and a copy count

72af351a1dc27d77c55bdda72090b9b48bb4fa80.statement: The book's title and author must not be empty.

7fb633551f985841740f3f69faa39fb0df5ffd78.statement: The system never allows two books to share the same ISBN; the system treats a repeat ISBN as a conflict, not a validation error.

8de21afe31f1b166f1d45908a980546ab363f3ce.statement: The copy count must be a whole number of at least 1.

0aabb2604c54b16b2ea1f32c90a808e4e806bbfc.statement: users can read a single book, including how many of its copies are currently available

99e0341dc5902ce864bb8dafd79470f03d500916.statement: the available count is the number of copies the library owns minus the number of copies

158522b8b2bf56ce4ae7a2b5a075fba48a31cc19.statement: The number of copies currently out on loan must never be negative.

a688b1bccc762a0c162ce9206f9ac8d3adf0ad43.statement: The system displays only books that have at least one copy available in the list.

0ae7e8a81ed9c2c25b77a27f6e03f346aadb017a.statement: a loan records which book was borrowed, which member borrowed it, when it was borrowed, when

2414b528d9d8ac4a98fc42df953d1e0bf8c053af.statement: it is due back, and when it was returned

a1232036a4f982aee8a34a81eb2276e0d6d741df.statement: The system assigns every loan a stable unique integer identifier.

e2a2f4c31f0cb1a92a1f8f93af9e856b7365779e.statement: users can borrow a book by naming an existing book and an existing member

f664bd467069609826d3acf36d9f6ad56bd916eb.statement: The system classifies borrowing a book that does not exist or naming a member who does not exist as a not-found error.

916f152aab5532352f913f5d09ffca97039b2aa9.statement: a loan is due 14 days after it is borrowed

bac26d6bdf8e9ad6efde0aade079b7b23a695347.statement: The system cannot allow borrowing of a book with no available copies.

1dcfd0c5b01704986cf87984a55963a3472eb67e.statement: A member has at most 3 active loans at once, and a fourth active loan is a conflict.

a814a361745557d84a099a4fad4dc0e4aec6b03a.statement: an active loan is one that has not been returned

7de135ad69a288bf0cd75fc23ebc584062b4e85b.statement: The user returns a loan, the system records the return date, and the system makes the copy available again.

45cf66d48414c553f4a72a476cf54d10a1b581ee.statement: Returning a loan that has already been returned constitutes a conflict.

14dd8a78f06f1ef604f7d84abfa721888c37e8af.statement: Returning a loan that does not exist produces a not-found error.

d617b59894b69dd813b29d66200b2f7f52cf7121.statement: users can list every loan, and can list only the active ones

95cecc6da8c3b3672dbb9df5c0aad1f6813ff0c7.statement: users can read a summary of the library: how many members are registered, how many distinct books

8557e569665716b7039bf568e459266b275e9dd2.statement: the library holds, how many copies are currently on loan, and how many loans are active

7f555374bc4fca20030955f9e0c3da106109f840.statement: The summary reflects every change immediately.

7aac8d52f4fc8952cad48e1f342b633ede61fcad.statement: the service exposes exactly these routes, and answers json on all of them:

6aea5cba7323266bfe5b69d40ca3ca75cdc4a6d6.statement: get /health — returns 200 once the service is ready

a6abbeaba6235d9fa3ce7a3e71e0d81b00d85d2c.statement: post /members — registers a member; returns 201 and the created member

5125e4e37159cd071e00bf9fea05feabd139b0c5.statement: get /members — returns 200 and a json array of members

a83827cc8dd3c900d54682ace059cdc5126fb9d4.statement: get /members/:id — returns 200 and the member, or 404

da4c133160fe885894950c954e200fccee5b3581.statement: The system returns 204 for DELETE /members/:id, returns 404 if no such member exists, or returns 409 if the member holds an active loan.

448841032e0d28ef9c02f77332f58da532928e57.statement: post /books — adds a book; returns 201 and the created book

19c1adbc82dc234a98bfebfc5082462ef784ec30.statement: get /books — returns 200 and a json array of books; get /books?available=true returns only

1e86e5018b7aa78e8c642d385588b62e48e17f9f.statement: The system displays books with at least one copy available.

1f892b7f6db4a69f6f406dbf91c3ad22c799bd6d.statement: get /books/:id — returns 200 and the book, or 404

de971684fa7958a6cb71385933dd175cec5911bb.statement: post /loans — borrows a book from a json body of { "book_id": n, "member_id": n }; returns 201

877963a89a4571732d82de2c050dbd9ea84ab646.statement: get /loans — returns 200 and a json array of loans; get /loans?active=true returns only loans

911b3846a53171dccfb6b0bafa7634d802140f3c.statement: The POST /loans/:id/return endpoint returns 200 and the returned loan.

4daa4f12ced4b7fe008ddbd8fada22bb7ecf3188.statement: status codes carry meaning and are part of the contract:

42ce1370fdced2125fd86443419e4c7877cfb831.statement: 400 — the body is malformed or a field is invalid

ba5530eff7939364f3c5a9bde502137c8e2f9587.statement: 404 — a named member, book or loan does not exist

cd658c20788da22692544c9a437f7083aeed3c4e.statement: 409 — the request was well formed and the library's rules forbid it: a duplicate email, a duplicate

fcdc7e371a9c2084a3aec8826823ba249c339c7b.statement: isbn, a book with no copies available, a member already holding 3 loans, a loan returned twice, or removing a member who still holds one

c29ba695db00f8651593d3c5b9de82c4fa25da24.statement: A member consists of id, name, email, joined_at, and active_loans, where active_loans is an integer.

b77d8286f590461d9daad8e7a142d5127af0186f.statement: a book is { id, title, author, isbn, copies_total, copies_available } where both counts are integers

4d3005e0e0df424c477f7d365cdb6502f926f341.statement: a loan is { id, book_id, member_id, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at } where returned_at is

6868a67ad207b4296199d541033daf6a98a2ac0a.statement: null until the loan comes back
